title: Edge of the World
setup: Black's king is stuck in the a1 corner, and your king on b3 covers a2 and b2.
hint: Your king already covers the squares above Black's king. Your rook only has to check it where it stands.
explanation:
## The Idea

Your king has done the hard work: on b3 it covers a2 and b2, so Black's king has only b1 left.

{{Rh1#}} checks along the first rank, and b1 is on the rook's line too. Nothing can block, and the king cannot reach the rook.

In a king and rook ending, your king takes the squares in front of the enemy king, and the rook checks from a distance.
